serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Hobo: So, did you find anything?
You: Not really.
Hobo: Tough luck, huh.
Hobo: I will spend quite some time here, so I will try to look around between my naps.
You: That’s…{{wi}} really nice of you.{{wi}} A bit uncharacteristic even…
Hobo: Oh come on. I’m not a monster and I can see that you are quite serious about it. 
Hobo: Besides, I help you, you someday will help me, you get the idea, right? Hehe~
He just wants me to owe him then…
You: Yeah, I get the idea.
You: I spent quite some time here already, I gotta go back.
Hobo: Sure, see you around kid.
